introduction: Montana’s refundable Earned Income Tax Credit is claimed through Form2 with the state income-tax return.
description: Montana’s refundable Earned Income Tax Credit is claimed through Form2 with the state income-tax return.

sections.who: Montana residency and same-year federal EITC eligibility matter. Part-year and special circumstances require the year-specific instructions.
sections.get: The credit is refundable. The 2025 rules use 10% of federal EITC; Revenue’s HB337 guidance increases it to 20% beginning tax year2026. Use the instructions for the year you are filing.
sections.docs:
• Federal return and EITC calculation.
  • Residency and earned-income records.
  • Correct-year Montana forms.
sections.apply:
1. Determine the tax year

    Do not apply a prior-year percentage automatically.

  2. Prepare Form2

    Use Revenue’s credit guidance and the applicable instructions.

  3. File the state return

    Use approved software or paper, retaining copies.
sections.after: Confirm any allocation or reduction before filing.
sections.sources: Checked October1,2026 using Revenue’s credit overview and HB337 tax-year changes. The credit percentage changes for tax year2026.

faqs: Can I claim it without filing state taxes?
